none.label: No Resize (Keep Original Rank)
none.desc: [Keep Original] Maintain the original LoRA's learned rank and expressive nuance (artstyle, pose, composition).

128.label: Target Rank 128 (Ultra High Detail)
128.desc: [Maximum Capacity] Best for complex art styles and dynamic compositions with massive detail. (Caution: Large file size).

64.label: Target Rank 64 (Standard High-Capacity LoRA)
64.desc: [High Detail & Complex Costumes] Effective for dynamic poses, intricate clothing, and accurate artist style reproduction.

32.label: Target Rank 32 (Balanced High Quality - Recommended)
32.desc: [Characters & Standard Outfits] Recommended setting for character reproduction, offering the best balance of quality and size reduction.

16.label: Target Rank 16 (Lightweight & Fast)
16.desc: [Simple Characters & Props] Great for simple poses and single items; optimizes file size for fast generation.

8.label: Target Rank 8 (Compact - Low VRAM)
8.desc: [Atmosphere & Simple Concepts] Minimal VRAM setting for subtle mood changes or basic concepts.

4.label: Target Rank 4 (Minimal)
4.desc: [Fine Tuning & Micro Size] Minimalist file size for slight color grading or tiny nuances.

keep.name: Keep Original Precision (FP16/BF16)
keep.desc: [Full Compatibility] Retains the original model format, ensuring maximum compatibility and zero quality loss.

fp8_e4m3fn.name: [RTX 40xx / 50xx] FP8 (e4m3fn) - High Quality 8-bit Float (~50% smaller)
fp8_e4m3fn.desc: [RTX 40xx/50xx Recommended] High-fidelity 8-bit float format with minimal loss and ~50% size reduction.

fp8_e5m2.name: [RTX 40xx / 50xx] FP8 (e5m2) - Wide Dynamic Range 8-bit Float (~50% smaller)
fp8_e5m2.desc: [Wide Dynamic Range] 8-bit float with wider exponent range to prevent numeric overflow.

int8.name: [RTX 20xx / 30xx / 40xx / 50xx] INT8 - Universal Integer Quant (~50% smaller)
int8.desc: [All RTX Generations] Standard 8-bit integer quantization supported widely across Turing/Ampere/Ada.

int4.name: [RTX 20xx / 30xx / 40xx / 50xx] INT4 / NF4 - 4-bit Quantization (~75% smaller)
int4.desc: [Ultra Low VRAM] Reduces file size by ~75% for maximum memory savings.

nvfp4.name: [RTX 50xx] NVFP4 / FP4 - Blackwell Native 4-bit Float (~75% smaller)
nvfp4.desc: [RTX 50xx Optimized] Native 4-bit floating point acceleration for next-gen Blackwell GPUs.

fp16.name: [All GPU / CPU] FP16 (Half Precision) - Standard 16-bit (~50% smaller if FP32)
fp16.desc: [Universal Standard] Standard 16-bit float format compatible across all GPUs and CPUs.
fp16.target_gpu: All GPUs (RTX / GTX / Radeon / Apple Silicon / CPU)

gguf_q4.name: [All GPU / CPU] GGUF Q4_K_M - ComfyUI-GGUF / sd.cpp (~70% smaller)
gguf_q4.desc: [ComfyUI-GGUF / sd.cpp] High-efficiency format directly readable by GGUF nodes.
